hypothesis: Improved quantum-feature capability may be expressible by cheap classical trigonometric features in this small circuit. Verify independently before attributing gains to quantum computing.
method: Conjugate each Pauli by the single CX and evaluate input product-state Bloch coordinates sin/cos. No statevectors in elementary control. Test every trained feature model and selected readout on independent inputs.
scope: Exact control for this specific2-qubit fixed encoder only; not a claim that arbitrary QNNs are efficiently classically simulable.
